rules.prepare:
RUBY_VERSION="3.3"
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR" autoreconf -vfi bh_autotools_dev_update
# The package for the tools folder is built natively, which needs no Ruby. # The one for the target is a cross build with the Ruby of the tools # folder: the Ruby it makes first would run the whole build in an emulator. # configure cannot run programs of the target then and gets the answers of # a native build from here. EXTRA_OPTS="--build=$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE"
if [ "$AELTRA_BUILD_FOR" = "target" ]; then EXTRA_OPTS="--build=$AELTRA_TOOLS_TYPE" EXTRA_OPTS="$EXTRA_OPTS --with-baseruby=/tools/bin/ruby$RUBY_VERSION"
export rb_cv_localtime_overflow=yes export ac_cv_func_memcmp_working=yes export ac_cv_func_fork_works=yes fi
# As in Alpine: configure does not see isnan and isinf, which are macros, # and libucontext is for processors that Ruby has no code of its own for. if [ "$AELTRA_LIBC_NAME" = "musl" ]; then export ac_cv_func_isnan=yes export ac_cv_func_isinf=yes export LIBS="$LIBS -lucontext" fi
# The options of Debian's rules, without multiarch. cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/configure" \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --target="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --sysconfdir=/etc \ --localstatedir=/var \ --program-suffix="$RUBY_VERSION" \ --with-soname=ruby-"$RUBY_VERSION" \ --with-sitedir="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/local/lib/site_ruby" \ --with-sitearchdir="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/local/lib/site_ruby" \ --enable-shared \ --enable-ipv6 \ --with-dbm-type=gdbm_compat \ --with-compress-debug-sections=no \ --disable-install-doc \ --disable-rpath \ --disable-yjit \ AS="${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE}-as" \ CC="${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE}-gcc" \ CXX="${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE}-g++" \ LD="${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE}-ld" \ PKG_CONFIG="${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE}-pkg-config" \ SHELL=/bin/sh \ $EXTRA_OPTS
rules.build:
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make V=1 -j"$AELTRA_PARALLEL_JOBS" main
# rbconfig.rb remembers the paths of the programs of the build, which # extensions are built with later, and the folder of the build. sed -i "s@$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR@BUILDDIR@g" rbconfig.rb
if [ "$AELTRA_BUILD_FOR" = "target" ]; then sed -i 's@/tools/bin@/usr/bin@g' rbconfig.rb fi
rules.install:
RUBY_API_VERSION="3.3.0"
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make V=1 DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" install-nodoc
cd "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX"
# As in Debian: the folders that extensions of the bundled gems were built # in, second copies of what is below gems/*/extensions, and lock files. rm -rf lib/ruby/gems/"$RUBY_API_VERSION"/gems/*/ext find lib/ruby/gems/"$RUBY_API_VERSION"/gems \ '(' -name '*.so' -o -name '*.o' -o -name '*.lock' ')' -exec rm -f '{}' +
# As in Debian: what programs that embed Ruby don't need. sed -i -e 's/^DLDFLAGS=.*/DLDFLAGS=/' -e 's/^LIBPATH=.*/LIBPATH=/' \ lib/pkgconfig/ruby-3.3.pc
